script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

MARY (35), a dedicated homemaker, prepares breakfast for her family. Her husband, RICHARD (45), a successful businessman, sits at the table, reading the newspaper. Their children, JENNY (10) and TOMMY (8), bounce around the room, playfully squabbling.

MARY
(smiling)
Good morning, dear. You're going to miss your bus if you don't hurry up.

RICHARD
(looking up)
I know, I'm trying to finish this article.

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER

The family sits in the living room, watching TV. A commercial for a new amusement park, "DreamWorld," catches their attention.

JENNY
(excitedly)
Mom, can we go to DreamWorld this summer?

MARY
(thoughtfully)
I'd love to, but your father and I need to talk about it first.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Richard and Mary sit at the dining room table, their faces serious.

RICHARD
Mary, I've been offered a position in New York. It's a fantastic opportunity, but it means a significant raise.

MARY
(surprised)
What does that mean for us?

RICHARD
It means we'll have to move.

MARY
(sighs)
And what about the children? Their school, their friends?

RICHARD
(concerned)
I know it's not easy, but think about the opportunities this move could bring for all of us.

INT. JENNY'S ROOM - DAY

Jenny sits on her bed, staring at a picture of DreamWorld. She looks sad and worried.

JENNY
(to herself)
I won't let this ruin our summer. I'll make it the best one ever.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

Mary and Richard discuss the move with Jenny and Tommy.

MARY
(looking at her children)
We'll make this transition as smooth as possible. You'll both have new opportunities in New York.

TOMMY
(whining)
But I don't want to leave my friends!

RICHARD
(reassuringly)
You'll make new friends, and you'll have an amazing new adventure.

INT. PARK - SUMMER

The family enjoys their last day at their old park before the move. They take pictures and have a picnic.

MARY
(looking at the camera)
Smile, kids. This is a moment we'll cherish forever.

As they pack up, Jenny and Tommy reminisce about their memories at the park.

JENNY
(tearfully)
I'll miss this place.

MARY
(hugging her)
But remember, new adventures are waiting for us.

INT. DREAMWORLD - AUTUMN

The family stands in front of the DreamWorld sign, taking it all in. Jenny and Tommy are excited, their eyes wide with wonder.

MARY
(smiling)
Welcome to DreamWorld.

RICHARD
(grinning)
This is just the beginning of our new adventures.

Fade out.

THE END
